body:
OBSERVED on the 2026-08-05T14:00Z tick.

`scripts/post-release-outreach.sh` printed `active gh user: new-usemame` and exited
cleanly at 14:06:39Z. One second later, at 14:06:40Z, `scripts/sync-wiki.sh` aborted
with:

    ABORT: gh active user is 'legitimate-apps', expected 'new-usemame'.

Both scripts compute the value with the identical expression:

    ACTIVE_USER="$(gh api user --jq .login 2>/dev/null || echo '')"

(post-release-outreach.sh:71, sync-wiki.sh:56)

So this is not a difference between the two checks. `gh` genuinely returned a
different login one second apart, in the same tick, from the same shell lineage.

NOT REPRODUCED on demand: re-running `gh api user --jq .login` by hand in the
project dir returns `new-usemame`, with neither GH_TOKEN nor GITHUB_TOKEN set, and
`gh auth status` shows new-usemame active / legitimate-apps inactive. The tick log
shows this is intermittent rather than a standing misconfiguration.

Leading hypothesis, UNVERIFIED: `gh api user` resolves the active account from
hosts.yml at call time, so any other process that runs `gh auth switch` (the
operator has a second authenticated account, `legitimate-apps`) flips it for every
subsequent step of an in-flight tick. That makes the tick's identity a shared
mutable global rather than something the tick pins at start.

Impact today is bounded: sync-wiki is a non-fatal WARN, so the tick continues and
only the wiki goes stale. The concern is the shape rather than this symptom. The
same expression guards `post-release-outreach.sh`, which posts publicly under an
identity, and identity separation is an operator absolute (Legitimate LLC must
never mix with new-usemame). A check that can read a different answer on each call
is the wrong instrument for a rule that strict, even where it currently fails safe.

Suggested direction, not yet implemented: resolve the login ONCE in the tick
preflight, export it, and have each step assert against the pinned value; or have
each step pass an explicit token rather than depending on ambient active-account
state. Either makes the identity a fixed property of the tick.
title: sync-wiki aborts on a wrong gh active user that the adjacent step reads correctly
